text: {"775":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"MIR local variables are defined by rustc_middle's MIR data structures and are represented by indexed locals."},"776":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"The MIR representation in rustc_middle contains both source locals and compiler-generated temporaries."},"777":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"MIR debug-variable annotations and their mappings from user names to places are MIR data structures defined in rustc_middle."},"778":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_mir_transform"],"refers":[],"why":"MIR debug-place mappings are defined in rustc_middle and can be altered or made nontrivial by MIR optimization transforms."},"779":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"Closure-capture debug mappings use the MIR debug-variable representation defined in rustc_middle."}}
